57400.meaning1: classes of perception; categories of recognition

examples.text: cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, saññākāyā, rūpasaññā, saddasaññā, gandhasaññā, rasasaññā, phoṭṭhabbasaññā, dhammasaññā. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, saññā.

57401.meaning1: aggregate of perception; mass of recognitions; third of the five aggregates

examples.text: pañcakkhandhā, rūpakkhandho vedanākkhandho saññākkhandho saṅkhārakkhandho viññāṇakkhandho.

57402.meaning1: field of perception; conceived world; mentally constructed reality
57402.commentary: (MNa) tato tena maggena adhigantabbaṭṭhānaṃ vicinanto atthi uttari imassa saññāgatassa nissaraṇan'ti pajānāti, imassa mayā adhigatassa brahmavihārasaññāgatassa uttari nissaraṇaṃ nibbānaṃ atthī'ti evaṃ pajānātī'ti adhippāyo, ettāvatānena nirodhasaccavavatthānaṃ kataṃ hoti.

examples.text: so atthi idaṃ, atthi hīnaṃ, atthi paṇītaṃ, atthi imassa saññāgatassa uttariṃ nissaraṇan'ti pajānāti.
so suññam'idaṃ saññāgataṃ gāmasaññāyā'ti pajānāti, suññam'idaṃ saññāgataṃ manussasaññāyā'ti pajānāti, atthi c'ev'idaṃ asuññataṃ yadidaṃ, araññasaññaṃ paṭicca ekattan'ti.

57403.meaning1: related to perception; concerning recognition; kind of perception; (comm) perception itself

examples.text: so yadeva tattha hoti rūpagataṃ vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṅkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ, te dhamme aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato samanupassati.

57404.commentary: (ANa) rūp'aggan'ti yaṃ rūpaṃ sammasitvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇāti, idaṃ rūp'aggaṃ nāma. sesesu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: katamāni cattāri? rūp'aggaṃ, vedanā'ggaṃ, saññā'ggaṃ, bhav'aggaṃ, imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri aggānī'ti.

57405.construction:
sayaṃ > saṃ + yāca + ika
saññāca + ika

57406.construction:
sayaṃ > saṃ + yāca + ikā
saññāca + ikā
57406.commentary: (VIN 1.2.6) saññācikā nāma sayaṃ yācitvā purisam'pi puris'atthakaram'pi goṇam'pi sakaṭam'pi vāsim'pi parasum'pi kuṭhārim'pi kudālam'pi nikhādanam'pi vallim'pi veḷum'pi muñjam'pi pabbajam'pi tiṇam'pi mattikam'pi.

examples.text: saññācikāya pana bhikkhunā kuṭiṃ kārayamānena assāmikaṃ att'uddesaṃ pamāṇikā kāretabbā, tatr'idaṃ pamāṇaṃ, dīghaso dvādasa vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ satt'antarā
sārambhe ce bhikkhu vatthusmiṃ aparikkamane saññācikāya kuṭiṃ kāreyya bhikkhū vā anabhineyya vatthudesanāya pamāṇaṃ vā atikkāmeyya, saṅgh'ādiseso.
ratanaṃ vā pana bhikkhunā ratanasammataṃ vā ajjhārāme vā ajjhāvasathe vā uggahetvā vā uggahāpetvā vā nikkhipitabban'ti rūpena vā nimittena vā saññāṇaṃ katvā nikkhipitvā ācikkhitabbaṃ

57408.commentary: (VINa) saññāṇaṃ katvā nikkhipitabban'ti kiñci nimittaṃ katvā ṭhapetabbaṃ.

examples.text: accekaṃ maññamānena bhikkhunā paṭiggahetabbaṃ paṭiggahetvā yāva cīvarakālasamayaṃ nikkhipitabban'ti saññāṇaṃ katvā nikkhipitabbaṃ, idaṃ accekacīvaran't
ahañ'hi, bhante, rathiko saññāto kusalo rathassa aṅgapaccaṅgānaṃ. sabbāni me rathassa aṅgapaccaṅgāni suviditāni. ṭhānaso'v'etaṃ maṃ paṭibhāseyyā'ti.

57410.meaning1: one's own kin; one's own family

examples.text: jātitthaddho dhanatthaddho, gottatthaddho ca yo naro, saññātiṃ atimaññeti, taṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.

57412.meaning1: realm of recognition; world of perception

examples.text: saññādhātu kho, gahapati, viññāṇassa oko. saññādhāturāgavinibandhañ'ca pana viññāṇaṃ, okasārī'ti vuccati.
vedanādhātuyā… saññādhātuyā… saṅkhāradhātuyā ce bhikkhave… viññāṇadhātuyā ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno rāgo pahīno hoti, rāgassa pahānā vocchijjat'ārammaṇaṃ patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa na hoti.

57413.meaning1: bound by desire to the realm of perception

examples.text: saññādhātu kho, gahapati, viññāṇassa oko. saññādhātu-rāgavinibandhañ'ca pana viññāṇaṃ okasārī'ti vuccati. saṅkhāradhātu kho, gahapati, viññāṇassa oko.

57414.meaning1: diversity of perceptions; variety of conceptions

examples.text: katame nava dhammā duppaṭivijjhā? nava nānattā, dhātunānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati phassanānattaṃ, phassanānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati vedanānānattaṃ, vedanānānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati saññānānattaṃ, saññānānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati saṅkappanānattaṃ, saṅkappanānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandanānattaṃ

57416.meaning1: fact of impermanence of perception; fact of instability of recognition

57417.meaning1: ending of perception; cessation of recognition

examples.text: saññā, bhikkhave, veditabbā, saññānaṃ nidānasambhavo veditabbo, saññānaṃ vemattatā veditabbā, saññānaṃ vipāko veditabbo, saññānirodho veditabbo, saññānirodhagāminī paṭipadā veditabbā.
phassasamudayā saññāsamudayo, phassanirodhā saññānirodho.

57418.meaning1: path of practice leading to the end of perception

examples.text: ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo saññānirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
saññā, bhikkhave, veditabbā, saññānaṃ nidānasambhavo veditabbo, saññānaṃ vemattatā veditabbā, saññānaṃ vipāko veditabbo, saññānirodho veditabbo, saññānirodhagāminī paṭipadā veditabbā.

57419.meaning1: leading to the end of perception

examples.text: ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo saññānirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
saññā, bhikkhave, veditabbā, saññānaṃ nidānasambhavo veditabbo, saññānaṃ vemattatā veditabbā, saññānaṃ vipāko veditabbo, saññānirodho veditabbo, saññānirodhagāminī paṭipadā veditabbā.

so evaṃ pajānāmi, micchādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ… micchāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, chandapaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, vitakkapaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, saññāpaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ

57422.meaning1: concept of perception; what is called recognition
57422.commentary: (MNa) phassapaññattiṃ paññapessatī'ti phasso nāma eko dhammo uppajjatī'ti evaṃ phassapaññattiṃ paññapessati, dassessatī'ti attho. esa nayo sabbattha.

examples.text: vedanāpaññattiyā sati saññāpaññattiṃ paññāpessatī'ti, ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjati. saññāpaññattiyā sati vitakkapaññattiṃ paññāpessatī'ti, ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjati.

57423.meaning1: way of acquiring a perception; acquisition of conception
57423.commentary: (MNt) diṭṭhi'y'eva paccayavasena paṭiladdhatāya diṭṭhipaṭilābho. saññāpaṭilābhe'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: saññāpaṭilābhaṃ'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, duvidhena vadāmi, sevitabbam'pi, asevitabbam'pi, tañ'ca aññam'aññaṃ saññāpaṭilābhaṃ.

57426.meaning2: should be known; should be recognized
57426.meaningLit: to cause to be known together

57427.meaning1: should be convinced; should be persuaded (to)
57427.meaningLit: to cause to be known together

examples.text: so n'eva ussādetabbo na apasādetabbo, anussādetvā anapasādetvā sv'eva sādhukaṃ saññāpetabbo tassa ca atthassa tesañ'ca byañjanānaṃ nisantiyā.

57428.meaning1: way to be persuaded; method to be convinced

examples.text: santaṃ'y'eva kho pana paraṃ lokaṃ n'atthi paro loko'ti āha, ye te arahanto paralokaviduno tesam'ayaṃ paccanīkaṃ karoti. santaṃ'y'eva kho pana paraṃ lokaṃ n'atthi paro loko'ti paraṃ saññāpeti, s'āssa hoti asaddhammasaññatti.
nikkhittamaṇisuvaṇṇā samaṇā sakyaputtiyā apetajātarūparajatā'ti. asakkhi kho maṇicūḷako gāmaṇi taṃ parisaṃ saññāpetuṃ.
n'eva kho asakkhi vāseṭṭho māṇavo bhāradvājaṃ māṇavaṃ saññāpetuṃ, na pana asakkhi bhāradvājo māṇavo'pi vāseṭṭhaṃ māṇavaṃ saññāpetuṃ.

so ce dūto taṃ veyyāvaccakaraṃ saññāpetvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya, yaṃ kho, bhante, āyasmā veyyāvaccakaraṃ niddisi, saññatto so mayā, upasaṅkamat'āyasmā kālena, cīvarena taṃ acchādessatī'ti.

so khv'āhaṃ, āvuso, vivicc'eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi. tassa mayhaṃ, āvuso, iminā vihārena viharato kāmasahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti.

57434.meaning1: made of awareness; made of perception

examples.text: arūpiṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, attānaṃ paccemi saññāmayan'ti. arūpī ca hi te, poṭṭhapāda, attā abhavissa saññāmayo, evaṃ santam'pi kho te, poṭṭhapāda, aññā'va saññā bhavissati añño attā.

ye pana te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino, atthi sabbaso āruppā'ti, sace tesaṃ bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ saccaṃ vacanaṃ, ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjati, ye te devā arūpino saññāmayā, apaṇṇakaṃ me tatr'ūpapatti bhavissati.

57435.meaning1: enjoying perception; taking pleasure in recognition

examples.text: saññ'ārāmassa kho, āvuso … saṅkhār'ārāmassa kho āvuso … viññāṇ'ārāmassa kho, āvuso, viññāṇaratassa viññāṇasammuditassa viññāṇanirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti … n'eva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti.

57436.meaning1: freed by the exhaustion of perception; liberated through the dissolution of conception

examples.text: saññāsaṅkhayavimutto kho, vaccha, tathāgato gambhīro appameyyo duppariyogāḷho, seyyathā'pi mahāsamuddo. upapajjatī'ti na upeti, na upapajjatī'ti na upeti, upapajjati ca na ca upapajjatī'ti na upeti, n'eva upapajjati na na upapajjatī'ti na upeti.

57437.meaning1: free from classification in terms of perception

examples.text: iti kho, bhikkhave, yāvatā saññāsamāpatti tāvatā aññāpaṭivedho.

57439.meaning1: arising from perception; stemming from recognition

examples.text: samuṭṭhānam'pi nesaṃ vuttaṃ. saññāsamuṭṭhānā'ti'ssa vacanīyaṃ. katamā saññā? saññā'pi hi bahū anekavidhā nānappakārakā. kāmasaññā, byāpādasaññā, vihiṃsāsaññā, itosamuṭṭhānā akusalā saṅkappā.

57440.meaning1: source of perception; arising of recognition

examples.text: phassasamudayā saññāsamudayo, phassanirodhā saññānirodho.

57448.meaning1: (understanding of the) subtlety of perception; fineness of recognition

examples.text: saññāsokhummena samannāgato hoti paramena, tena ca saññāsokhummena aññaṃ saññāsokhummaṃ uttaritaraṃ vā paṇītataraṃ vā na samanupassati, tena ca saññāsokhummena aññaṃ saññāsokhummaṃ uttaritaraṃ vā paṇītataraṃ vā na pattheti.
saññaṃ attato samanupassati, saññāvantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā saññaṃ, saññāya vā attānaṃ. ahaṃ saññā, mama saññā'ti pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyī hoti.

57451.meaning1: end of perception and consciousness; disappearance of recognition and knowing

examples.text: nandībhavaparikkhayā, saññāviññāṇasaṅkhayā, vedanānaṃ nirodhā upasamā, evaṃ khv'āhaṃ āvuso jānāmi sattānaṃ nimokkhaṃ pamokkhaṃ vivekan'ti.
tassa saññāvipariṇām'aññathābhāvā uppajjanti soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā.

57453.meaning1: deluded conception; distortion of perception; inversion of perception

examples.text: anicce, bhikkhave, niccan'ti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso. dukkhe, bhikkhave, sukhan'ti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso.

57454.commentary: (NIDD2) saññāvimokkhe parame'dhimutto'ti saññāvimokkhā vuccanti satta saññāsamāpattiyo. tāsaṃ saññāsamāpattīnaṃ ākiñcaññ'āyatana-samāpatti-vimokkho aggo ca seṭṭho ca viseṭṭho ca pāmokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro ca, parame agge seṭṭhe viseṭṭhe pāmokkhe uttame pavare adhimuttivimokkhena adhimutto tatr'ādhimutto tadadhimutto taccarito tabbahulo taggaruko tanninno tappoṇo tappabbhāro tadadhimutto tadadhipateyyo'ti, saññāvimokkhe parame'dhimutto. (SNPa) saññāvimokkhe parame'ti sattasu saññāvimokkhesu uttame ākiñcaññ'āyatane.

examples.text: sabbesu kāmesu yo vītarāgo, ākiñcaññaṃ nissito hitvā m'aññaṃ, saññāvimokkhe parame'dhimutto, tiṭṭheyya so tattha anānuyāyī.

57455.meaning1: non-liability due to not perceiving something as an offence
57455.meaning2: release from a disciplinary offense by not perceiving an action as an offense
57455.commentary: (VINa) dukesu sacittakā āpatti saññāvimokkhā, acittakā nosaññāvimokkhā. (VINt) nappaṭinissajjāmī'ti saññāya abhāvena muccanato saññāvimokkhaṃ. (KVa) sabbāpattiyo ca saññāvasena duvidhā honti saññāvimokkhā nosaññāvimokkhā'ti. tattha yato vītikkamasaññāya abhāvena muccati, ayaṃ saññāvimokkhā, itarā nosaññāvimokkhā.

examples.text: tatrā'pi atthi saññāvimokkhaṃ, atthi nosaññāvimokkhaṃ. tattha yaṃ citt'aṅgaṃ labhati'y'eva, taṃ saññāvimokkhaṃ, itaraṃ nosaññāvimokkhaṃ.

57456.meaning1: detached from perception; indifferent to concepts

examples.text: saññāvirattassa na santi ganthā, paññāvimuttassa na santi mohā, saññañ'ca diṭṭhiñ'ca ye aggahesuṃ, te ghaṭṭayantā vicaranti loke'ti.

57457.meaning1: skilled in the expansion of perception
57457.commentary: (ANt) sabbaso rūpasaññānan'ti-ādinā (dha. sa. 265) vuttasaññā atikkamitvā ākās'ānañc'āyatana-saññā-sahagataṃ… n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatana-saññāsahagatan'ti (dha. sa. 265-268) saññāsīsena vuttajjhānānaṃ vivaṭṭakusalo, tathā itthipuris'ādisaññā niccasaññ'ādito cittaṃ vivaṭṭetvā kevale rūp'ārūpadhammamatte asaṅkhate nibbāne ca visesato vaṭṭanato ca suññat'ānupassanābahulo saññāvivaṭṭakusalo.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ saññāvivaṭṭakusalānaṃ yadidaṃ mahāpanthako.

57458.meaning1: due to the subsiding of perception

examples.text: so evaṃ pajānāmi… saññāpaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, saññāvūpasama-paccayā'pi vedayitaṃ
te ca h'āvuso, āyusaṅkhārā abhaviṃsu te vedaniyā dhammā, na'y'idaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa bhikkhuno vuṭṭhānaṃ paññāyetha.

57460.meaning1: ending of recognition and feeling; cessation of conception and what is felt

examples.text: te ca h'āvuso, āyusaṅkhārā abhaviṃsu te vedaniyā dhammā, na'y'idaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa bhikkhuno vuṭṭhānaṃ paññāyetha.
idha mayaṃ, bhante, yāva'd'eva ākaṅkhāma sabbaso n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharāma, paññāya ca no disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā

57461.meaning1: state of the ending of recognition and feeling; element of cessation of conception and what is felt
57461.commentary: (SNa) saññāvedayitanirodho'va saññāvedayitanirodhadhātu. iti bhagavā anusandhikusalassa bhikkhuno tattha nisīditvā pañhaṃ pucchitu'kāmassa okāsaṃ dento desanaṃ niṭṭhāpesi.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, yā c'āyaṃ, bhante, ābhādhātu yā ca subhadhātu yā ca ākās'ānañc'āyatanadhātu yā ca viññāṇ'añc'āyatanadhātu yā ca ākiñcaññ'āyatanadhātu yā ca n'evasaññ'ānāsaññ'āyatanadhātu yā ca saññāvedayitanirodhadhātu, imā nu kho, bhante, dhātuyo kiṃ paṭicca paññāyantī'ti?

57462.meaning1: meditation attainment of cessation of conception and what is felt

examples.text: tatiyassa jhānassa pīti kaṇṭako, catutthassa jhānassa assāsapassāso kaṇṭako, saññāvedayitanirodha-samāpattiyā saññā ca vedanā ca kaṇṭako, rāgo kaṇṭako doso kaṇṭako moho kaṇṭako.
na kho, gahapati, saññāvedayitanirodha-samāpattiyā vuṭṭhahantassa bhikkhuno evaṃ hoti, ahaṃ saññāvedayitanirodha-samāpattiyā vuṭṭhahissan'ti vā ahaṃ saññāvedayitanirodha-samāpattiyā vuṭṭhahāmī'ti

57463.meaning1: (gram) desire to make a noun; change of identity

examples.text: tato paraṃ sarīrassa abbhantare yakanasaññitaṃ yamakamaṃsapiṇḍaṃ vaṇṇato rattaṃ rattakumuda-bāhira-patta-piṭṭhi-vaṇṇan'ti vavatthapeti.

57465.meaning2: theory of percipience of self after death

examples.text: tasmā't'iha, moggallāna, yathāsaññissa te viharato taṃ middhaṃ okkamati taṃ saññaṃ mā manas'ākāsi taṃ saññaṃ mā bahulam'akāsi
na saññasaññī na visaññasaññī, no'pi asaññī na vibhūtasaññī, evaṃ sametassa vibhoti rūpaṃ, saññānidānā hi papañcasaṅkhā.
papañcasaññā itar'ītarā narā, papañcayantā upayanti saññino, manomayaṃ gehasitañ'ca sabbaṃ, panujja nekkhammasitaṃ irīyati.

ek'ūnapaññāsa ājīvakasate, ek'ūnapaññāsa paribbājakasate, ek'ūnapaññāsa nāg'āvāsasate, vīse indriyasate, tiṃse nirayasate, chattiṃsa rajodhātuyo, satta saññīgabbhā, satta asaññīgabbhā, satta nigaṇṭhigabbhā

57469.commentary: (ANa) saññī'm'eva nu kho'ti sacittako'y'eva nu kho. makāro padasandhimattaṃ.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte āyasmā udāyī āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca, saññī'm'eva nu kho, āvuso ānanda, tadāyatanaṃ no paṭisaṃvedeti udāhu asaññī'ti? saññī'm'eva kho, āvuso, tadāyatanaṃ no paṭisaṃvedeti, no asaññī'ti.

apar'ant'ānudiṭṭhiyā katamehi catucattālīsāya ākārehi abhiniveso hoti? soḷasa saññīvādā, aṭṭha asaññīvādā, aṭṭha n'evasaññī-n'āsaññī-vādā, satta ucchedavādā, pañca diṭṭhadhammanibbānavādā, apar'ant'ānudiṭṭhiyā imehi catucattālīsāya ākārehi abhiniveso hoti.
uddham'āghātanikā'ti āghātanaṃ vuccati maraṇaṃ, uddham'āghātanā attānaṃ vadantī'ti uddham'āghātanikā. saññī'ti pavatto vādo, saññīvādo, so etesaṃ atthī'ti saññīvādā.

57471.meaning1: holding a doctrine of percipient (post-mortem existence)
57471.meaning2: holding the doctrine of percipient (post-mortem existence)

examples.text: santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā uddham'āghātanikā saññīvādā uddham'āghātanaṃ saññiṃ attānaṃ paññapenti soḷasahi vatthūhi.

57472.synonym: ābaddha, gathita, gadhita, naddha, baddha, sita
57472.commentary: (SNa) saññutto naṃ vedayatī'ti kilesehi sampayutto'va hutvā taṃ vedanaṃ vedayati, na vippayutto. (SNa) saññutto dukkhasmā'ti karaṇ'atthe nissakkaṃ, dukkhena sampayutto'ti attho.

examples.text: so sukhañ'ce vedanaṃ vedayati, saññutto naṃ vedayati. dukkhañ'ce vedanaṃ vedayati, saññutto naṃ vedayati. adukkham'asukhañ'ce vedanaṃ vedayati, saññutto naṃ vedayati.

57473.meaning1: attached to perception; attracted to percepts; engaged with conception

examples.text: vedan'upayaṃ… saññ'upayaṃ… saṅkhār'upayaṃ vā, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya, saṅkhār'ārammaṇaṃ saṅkhārappatiṭṭhaṃ nand'ūpasecanaṃ vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyya.

57474.meaning1: accumulation of recognition that is clung to; mass of recognized concepts that are grasped

examples.text: katame c'āvuso, pañc'upādānakkhandhā? seyyath'idaṃ, rūp'upādānakkhandho, vedan'upādānakkhandho, saññ'upādānakkhandho, saṅkhār'upādānakkhandho, viññāṇ'upādānakkhandho.

kummo'ti kho, bhikkhu, pañcann'etaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ adhivacanaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, rūp'upādānakkhandhassa, vedan'upādānakkhandhassa, saññ'upādānakkhandhassa, saṅkhār'upādānakkhandhassa, viññāṇ'upādānakkhandhassa.

57475.meaning1: arising of perception; appearance of recognition

examples.text: saññā kho, poṭṭhapāda, paṭhamaṃ uppajjati, pacchā ñāṇaṃ, saññ'uppādā ca pana ñāṇ'uppādo hoti. so evaṃ pajānāti, idappaccayā kira me ñāṇaṃ udapādī'ti.

57476.meaning1: accumulation of recognition that is clung to; mass of recognized concepts that are grasped

examples.text: seyyath'īdaṃ rūp'ūpādānakkhandho, vedan'ūpādānakkhandho, saññ'ūpādānakkhandho, saṅkhār'ūpādānakkhandho, viññāṇ'ūpādānakkhandho

57477.meaning1: attached to perception; attracted to recognition; engaged with conception

examples.text: vedan'ūpāyaṃ vā āvuso… saññ'ūpāyaṃ vā, āvuso… saṅkhār'ūpāyaṃ vā, āvuso, viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭhati saṅkhār'ārammaṇaṃ saṅkhārappatiṭṭhaṃ nand'ūpasecanaṃ vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjati.

57478.commentary: (MNa) kadā saññūḷhā'ti kadā sampiṇḍitā. evaṃ kir'assa ahosi ayaṃ idān'eva samaṇassa gotamassa santikaṃ gantvā āgato, kad'ānena ete vaṇṇā sampiṇḍitā'ti. tasmā evam'āha.

examples.text: kadā saññūḷhā pana te, gahapati, ime samaṇassa gotamassa vaṇṇā'ti?

57480.meaning1: fetter; chain; bond; thing which binds

examples.text: pañca oram'bhāgiyāni saññojanāni, sakkāyadiṭṭhi, vicikicchā, sīlabbataparāmāso, kāmacchando, byāpādo.
yaṃ samaṇo bahuṃ bhāsati, upetaṃ atthasañhitaṃ, jānaṃ so dhammaṃ deseti, jānaṃ so bahu bhāsati.
yo c'āyaṃ attakilamath'ānuyogo dukkho anariyo anatthasañhito.

57482.meaning1: dregs; rubbish; worst part; waste product
57482.commentary: (VINa) tiṇakaṭṭhapaṇṇasaṭan'ti tattha tattha patitaṃ tiṇakaṭṭhapaṇṇaṃ. atha vā tiṇañ'ca nissārakaṃ lahukaṃ kaṭṭhañ'ca tiṇakaṭṭhaṃ. paṇṇasaṭan'ti purāṇapaṇṇaṃ.

examples.text: tattha ca me, brāhmaṇa, viharato mago vā āgacchati, moro vā kaṭṭhaṃ pāteti, vāto vā paṇṇasaṭaṃ ereti, tassa mayhaṃ brāhmaṇa etadahosi, etaṃ nūna taṃ bhayabheravaṃ āgacchatī'ti.

57484.commentary: (DNa) saṭṭhā'ti vissaṭṭhā. sammā avayā saṭṭhā esanā assā'ti samavayasaṭṭh'esano. sammā vissaṭṭhasabba-esano'ti attho.

examples.text: dasa ariyavāsā. idh'āvuso, bhikkhu pañc'aṅgavippahīno hoti, chaḷaṅgasamannāgato, ek'ārakkho, catur'āpasseno, paṇunnapaccekasacco, samavayasaṭṭh'esano, anāvilasaṅkappo, passaddhakāyasaṅkhāro, suvimuttacitto, suvimuttapañño.
yāni ca tīṇi yāni ca saṭṭhi, samaṇappavādasitāni bhūripañña, saññ'akkharasaññanissitāni, osaraṇāni vineyya oghatam'agā.
idam'avoca bhagavā. attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandun'ti. imasmiṃ ca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne saṭṭhimattānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anupādāya āsavehi cittāni vimucciṃsū'ti.

57486.commentary: (SNa) ajjasaṭṭhiṃ na dissantī'ti ajja chadivasamattakā paṭṭhāya na dissanti.

57487.construction:
cha + dasa + i + ka
saṭṭhi + ka

examples.text: chanden'aṭṭhārasa honti, atītena ca dve nava, yadanicc'āṭṭhārasa vuttā, tayo ajjhattabāhirā, peyyālo saṭṭhiko vutto, buddhen'ādiccabandhunā'ti.

57491.meaning1: dependent on sixty (wrong views); (comm) dependent on the six sense fields
57491.commentary: (SNa) atha saṭṭhinissitā savitakkā, puthū janatāya adhammā niviṭṭhā'ti atha cha ārammaṇanissitā puthū adhammavitakkā janatāya niviṭṭhā'ti attho.

examples.text: atha saṭṭhinissitā savitakkā, puthū janatāya adhammā niviṭṭhā, na ca vaggagatassa kuhiñci, no pana duṭṭhullabhāṇī sa bhikkhu.

57492.meaning2: Chapter 17 of the Saḷāyatanasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 4 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

examples.text: vessabhussa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa tayo sāvakānaṃ sannipātā ahesuṃ. eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi asītibhikkhusahassāni, eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi sattatibhikkhusahassāni, eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi saṭṭhibhikkhusahassāni.
idam'avoca bhagavā. attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandun'ti. imasmiṃ ca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne saṭṭhimattānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anupādāya āsavehi cittāni vimucciṃsū'ti.

57496.meaning1: sixty years of age; sixty years old

examples.text: pañcadvārikā pavatte pañcadvāravasena pavattamānā paṭhamavaye vīsativassakāle rajjanadussanamuyhanavasena adhimattā balavatī hoti, paṇṇāsavassakāle ṭhitā hoti, saṭṭhivassakālato paṭṭhāya parihāyamānā asītinavutivassakāle mandā hoti.

57497.meaning1: living for one hundred and sixty years; with a lifespan of one hundred and sixty years

examples.text: saṭṭhivassasat'āyukānaṃ manussānaṃ vīsatitivassasat'āyukā puttā bhavissanti…
vessabhussa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa saṭṭhivassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.
saṭṭhivassasahassāni, paripuṇṇāni sabbaso, niraye paccamānānaṃ, kadā anto bhavissati.
